Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (offscreen) Imagine you're a teenager...

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: 1957! You place your shiny, hard-earned nickel into the coin slot! Think of it: all your favorite bands playing all their greatest hits at any time you want! You make your selection, guiding your chosen 45-RPM disc onto the magical turning table, center stage! Then, like a gentle nurse, an arm holding a needle lowers itself and finds its way into the groove! You turn around knowing the song you've chosen more than anything else tells the world what you're all about!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Hmm... and this leads directly to the 1960s. (unplugs the jukebox) Oh, well, time to get this beaut to the antique shop. (wheels it away) Ta, boys!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All your favorites bands playing all their greatest hits any time you want. Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today! Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning Agent P, we have a situation, the royal Princess Baldegunde of Drusselstein is in town. She's here to give the "Drusselsteinian Favorite Son" Award to Mayor Roger Doofenshmirtz during the unveiling of the new Danville Opera House. We assume Dr. Doofenshmirtz will do something to disrupt the ceremony. He's been buying up all the claw machines in the Tri-State Area. We don't know exactly what his plan is, but do the math: Princess, Opera house, claw machine, stuffed animal. You put that together and you get a...Claw-Princess-Animal, uh, Stuffed-Claw-House--

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Uh, ooh ooh ooh ooh...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Or a...or a, Singing Animal Claw-

Name: Carl
Dialog: Clawpera House,

Name: Carl
Dialog: Stuffy Stuffness!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: A Singing Claw-

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Clawing

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Clawing House with a-

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: It's terrifying, you must stop Doofenshmirtz and make sure the princess is safe. We don't actually have a photo of her, but whatever, she's a 15-year-old girl, they all pretty much look alike... Carl, put up a picture of a 15-year-old girl! (A picture of Candace appears on screen).... Uh now put a crown on her. (A crown is superimposed onto Candace's head) There! There's your princess.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Oh wait sir, I found a picture of the actual princess.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: All right, put it up there. (A picture of the princess appears and she has an uncanny resemblance to Candace) Oh, wow, what are the odds?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Well, it is a cartoon, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What did I tell you about breaking the fourth wall, Carl?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Sorry, sir.

Name: Man
Dialog: (Drusselsteinian accent) At two o'clock, you have gala ball. At 2:30, you have premiere gala. At three o'clock, you have Gala-Gala Oxen Free.

Name: Princess Baldegunde
Dialog: (looking up from a magazine, also speaking in a Drusselsteinian accent) Yes, yes. But when do we make shopping at fun American mall time?

Name: Man
Dialog: Well, we have eleven minutes until gala gathering, so maybe we make six minutes for American shopping at mall.

Name: Princess Baldegunde
Dialog: (gasps) Oh, thank you, Royal Fake Daddy Chaperone Servant Guiserblint!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on phone) Ah, Stacy, I tell my mom I'm heading to the mall to get some makeup and she hands me a list of other stuff I have to get. Why do I have to do everything? Shop at the mall, bust my brothers.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Technically, you don't have to bust your brothers.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, really, Stacy? Well, they're not gonna bust themselves! Oh, great, a sale. Now guess who's gonna have to go in there and try stuff on? Call ya later, Stace. (hangs up and walks in) Since I have to do everything! (gasps)

Name: Princess Baldegunde
Dialog: You are my doppelgänger!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Your doppel-who?

Name: Princess Baldegunde
Dialog: My mythological exact twin! My double who walks Earth same as me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Woah! Cool! I wonder if I have a doppelgänger, too.

Name: Princess Baldegunde
Dialog: Yes, that is me. We are for each other doppelgängers.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait a second. Does this mean if we accidentally touch, we'll rip apart the very fabric of the universe?

Name: Princess Baldegunde
Dialog: Maybe. (She touches her twin's shirt, nothing happens) We live! I am Princess Baldegunde of Drusselstein.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And I am Candace of Flynn.

Name: Princess Baldegunde
Dialog: We should hang out today and make freaking out on unsuspecting passersby.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'd love to, but I gotta finish shopping and get back to my brothers who are making some impossible thing in the backyard.

Name: Princess Baldegunde
Dialog: (gasps) You make life like American teenage girls on TV! For me, I do nothing, because everything is done for me at clap of hands. (clap clap)

Name: Guiserblint
Dialog: Yes, Your Highness?

Name: Princess Baldegunde
Dialog: No, no, sorry. You may go.

Name: Guiserblint
Dialog: I may go. (leaves)

Name: Princess Baldegunde
Dialog: See? I never get to do anything for myself.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And I have to do everything for myself.

Name: Candace and Princess Baldegunede
Dialog: (gasp) I got it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let's go to the laundromat and fill the dryers with cheese!

Name: Princess Baldegunde
Dialog: What?! No! Let us trade lives. Oh! I thought for sure on same page we were. Hmm. Come, Candace of Flynn.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, trade lives! Yeah, good.

Name: Princess Baldegunde
Dialog: Wow! Never before has such cheap fabric touched royal skin.

Name: Candace
Dialog: This is like I'm wearing a cloud of butter. Say, don't princesses need to know a lot of manners and stuff?

Name: Princess Baldegunde
Dialog: Nope. (putting her crown on Candace's head) All you need is this. (gasp) They come! Remember, clap clap. (she runs off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (waves) Good luck.

Name: Guiserblint
Dialog: Did you enjoy your six minutes in the mall, Your Royal Highness?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes...I...am. (clap clap) Bring me a glass of water (Guiserblint produces a glass) and a cracker. (A woman behind her gets a cracker.) Okay, bring me an x-ray of a kangaroo with three legs. (Guiserblint shows the X-ray, while another man holds up three mannequin legs) No, no, the kangaroo has three legs. (Another man shows the x-ray of the kangaroo with three legs) Ah! There you go.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I guess we could send out invitations, but that's the good thing about a giant jukebox: You build it, the party comes to you.

Name: Princess Baldegunde
Dialog: Pinnayus and Ferb! Just look at you two! You two are my younger brothers! And of course, I am Candace, your big sister, am I not?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes...

Name: Princess Baldegunde
Dialog: "Yes" is correct! And shall we play together today, yes?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Mm, sure. We're gonna construct a giant jukebox here in the backyard.

Name: Princess Baldegunde
Dialog: (clapping) Oh, goody! Giant construction project is my most favorite game!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas! Whatcha doin'?

Name: Princess Baldegunde
Dialog: Today, we shall make play here in the backyard as constructor persons. And we shall make a giant-sized jukebox. It is a most joyful way for all of us to make play, is it not?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm outta here.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus. It's ironic that you look like a stuffed animal in one of those claw machine games. And by "ironic"... (Doof pushes a button on the claw machine, and the claw grabs Perry, trapping him) I mean "totally flat-out ronic." And speaking of claw machines, (showing a joystick on another side of the blimp) I've gathered up all the arcade claw machines in the Tri-State Area to make one giant Super Claw (cut to the Super Claw under the blimp)....inator. My fascination with these started when I was just a little boy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) Back in Gimmelshtump, one day, when I was walking through the Claw Machine District, something caught my eye. In this machine that usually just has rocks in it, there was an actual teddy bear! Fortunately, I had with me my allowance, which I'd been saving for a whole year: one three-cent coin. I dropped it into a slot, and carefully maneuvered the claw toward the beckoning fuzzy grail! Odds were against me, but then it happened! The miracle! The claw grabbed the stuffed animal; it was mine! Then, like a knight of yore, I gallantly gave the prize to my beloved mother... who immediately turned around and gave it to my brother, Roger. I was crushed as I watched Roger produce a big red marker and write his name on the toy. And then afterwards proceed to do the same to my mother, claiming both as his own, and effectively shutting me out of the family dynamic.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So now, with my giant claw, I will wreak vengeance on my brother, and take away his giant opera house! (Evil laugh) So, what's new with you?

Name: Guiserblint
Dialog: And where would you like your bucket of gold?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, just put it there at the end. (Guiserblint pours some more gold at the end of the rug. Candace takes off her shoes.) Okay, you can go now. (She lifts her dress up and runs gleefully through the coins in her bare feet. She stops and a record needle scratch is heard.) Wow, I've been given all this power and how I've chosen to use it is to run through gold coins barefoot....I'm a genius!! (runs back to the throne) Ha ha ha!

Name: Princess Baldegunde
Dialog: Okay, now I hammer. (clap clap) Hammer? (clap clap) Hammer?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Your legs do not appear to be broken.

Name: Princess Baldegunde
Dialog: You are right! Broken, they are not! I can be fetching hammer for myself, can I not? (runs off) Here I go! Never so much fun have I had!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow! Candace really seems to be enjoying herself today.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: And she seems to have acquired an upper-class Drusselsteinian speech pattern.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah. Let's just go with it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And the giant jukebox is done! Now all we need to do is fill it with music.

Name: Princess Baldegunde
Dialog: Hello, cute blonde boy with guitar.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey...cute redhead...talking funny. See ya after the set.

Name: Guiserblint
Dialog: Her Majesty would like to run through gold with no shoes?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nah, been there, done that. (Guiserblint leaves) Wow. Absolute power bores absolutely. (Her phone rings, she picks up) Hello?

Name: Princess Baldegunde
Dialog: Candace? I need to ask you question. How is pronounce the name of cute blond boy with guitar?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (suspiciously) What cute blond boy?

Name: Princess Baldegunde
Dialog: The one with band! Is it "Jer-EH-mee" or "Jer-ME"?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's pronounced, "Stay away from him!" (The Princess hangs up and Candace gets a dial tone) Hello? Hello? Okay, that tears it! (Takes off the Princess' dress revealing her regular wardrobe underneath) That's enough princess for today! I want my life back! (runs off)

Name: Guiserblint
Dialog: (chasing after her) Your Majesty! City Hall Opera Gala is about to begin!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stay away from Jeremy! Is this a giant jukebox? Have you told Mom yet?

Name: Princess Baldegunde
Dialog: I should be telling of the Mother?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, stay right here! I'll be right back!

Name: Guiserblint
Dialog: Your Highness! Your Highness! (gasps) Ceremony is about to start! (takes the Princess' hand) We go now!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You're messing up my trajectory! (Perry grabs the joystick, which drops the Giant Claw-inator and grabs hold of the jukebox)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (approaching her mother) Mom! Mom! Giant jukebox! Come on! Come on! (Candace runs outside to see the blimp take the jukebox. Linda follows.) You missed it. Giant jukebox, doppelgänger, everything, all gone.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Cool.

Name: Guiserblint
Dialog: To celebrate ze linking of the two cultures and ze lifetime achievements of Roger Doofenshmirtz, vill you please join me in velcoming Princess Baldegunde of Drusselstein!

Name: Princess Baldegunde
Dialog: Like Roger Doofenshmirtz, I grew up in a very different country.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (once again fighting over the joystick) Perry the Platypus, stop it! I-I have to put down this jukebox so I can pick up the Opera House!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I did it! I...Not strictly according to plan, but I...Still, I have disrupted the ceremony. WOOT! WOOT! See? Everything works with the woot-woots.

Name: Princess Baldegunde
Dialog: It is a jukebox! It is our jukebox! Oh, this is most wonderful! Citizens of Danville, I had been come here today to give you long boring speech, but no longer. Instead, I give to you... (she runs up to the top of the roof with a quarter in her hand, which she shows) twenty-five American cents! (She puts the quarter in the jukebox and pushes Jeremy and the Incidentals.) Time for everybody to make play as happy dancing persons! Here is Cute Blonde Boy with Guitar!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Here we go!

Name: Man
Dialog: A giant jukebox! They built it! Let's bring the party to them!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh! Oh, no! Everyone is enjoying themselves! E-Even Roger! Oh, my plan has failed! Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry! I'm glad you weren't in the jukebox, wherever that went.
